# dependencytrack_user_login (Data Source)

Authenticate using Username and password.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dependencytrack_user_login" "example" {
  username = "admin"
  password = "admin"
}

output "bearer_token" {
  value = data.dependencytrack_user_login.example.token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for Managed User within DependencyTrack.
- `username` (String) Username within DependencyTrack.

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) DependencyTrack bearer token.
